# MRS Car Rental

> Premium chauffeur-driven car rental service in Lagos and Abuja, Nigeria, offering luxury sedans, SUVs, and executive vehicles for corporate, airport, and event transportation.

MRS Car Rental provides professional chauffeur-driven vehicle hire across Nigeria, with a focus on Lagos and Abuja. Services include airport pickups, corporate transportation, wedding cars, and long-term executive rentals.
